ei.title: Practice 03 — 인터넷의 정보를 평가할 수 있는 비판적 사고능력의 중요성
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is ②<u>democratic</u> ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly ③<u>dispense</u> wisdom, it contains the views not only of ④<u>credentialed</u> experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and ①<u>trustworthy</u> information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷의 장점은 민주적이라는 것이지만 단점은 품질 관리가 없다는 것이다. 인터넷은 자격 갖춘 전문가와 무지한 사람들 모두의 견해를 담는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① democratic — 'it is democratic', 형용사 보어 정상
✅ ③ dispense(오류) — 'Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom', Far from being 뒤 oracle을 수식하는 현재분사 dispensing이 맞음. 원형 dispense는 분사 역할 불가 ←정답
❌ ② credentialed — 'credentialed experts', 형용사 수식 정상
❌ ④ trustworthy — 'trustworthy information', 형용사 수식 정상
det.tip: oracle dispensing wisdom: oracle이 지혜를 분배하는 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 dispensing. 원형 dispense는 분사 역할 불가

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, accurate and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy ①<u>to find</u>. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are ②<u>determined</u> by ③<u>popular</u> rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories ④<u>surrounding</u> events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 유용한 정보가 많지만 항상 쉽게 찾을 수 있는 것은 아니다. 검색 순위는 인기가 아닌 진실에 의해 결정된다. 9/11을 둘러싼 음모론은 순위가 높다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① popular(오류) — 전치사 by 뒤에는 명사 popularity가 맞음. 형용사 popular는 전치사 목적어 불가 ←정답
❌ ② determined — 'page rankings are determined by popularity', 수동태 be+p.p. 정상
❌ ③ to find — 'not always easy to find', 형용사적 to부정사 정상
❌ ④ surrounding — 'conspiracy theories surrounding events', 현재분사 수식 정상
det.tip: 전치사 by 뒤에는 명사(구) 필요. by popularity(명사) 정상, by popular(형용사) 불가

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is ①<u>that</u> it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle ②<u>infallibly</u> dispensing wisdom, it ③<u>containing</u> the views not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills ④<u>to evaluate</u> it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷의 장점은 민주적이라는 것이다. 전자 신탁과 거리가 먼 인터넷은 다양한 견해를 담는다. 오도를 피하려면 비판적 사고로 정보를 평가해야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① that — 'The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic', that절 보어 정상
❌ ② infallibly — 'infallibly dispensing wisdom', 부사 수식 정상
✅ ③ containing(오류) — 주어 it에 대한 본동사 자리. contains(동사)가 맞음. containing(현재분사)으로 쓰면 주절 동사가 사라져 문장 성립 불가 ←정답
❌ ④ to evaluate — 'the critical thinking skills to evaluate it', 형용사적 to부정사 정상
det.tip: 주절에는 반드시 동사(V) 필요. contains(동사) 정상, containing(현재분사)으로 바꾸면 동사 없어짐

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. ①<u>Far from being</u> an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views ②<u>not only</u> of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than truth. So if we are to avoid ④<u>misleading</u>, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷은 전자 신탁과 거리가 멀다. 자격 갖춘 전문가뿐 아니라 무지한 사람들의 견해도 담는다. 음모론은 검색 순위 상위에 오를 것 같다. 오도를 피하려면 비판적 사고가 필요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Far from being — 관용구 'Far from being an electronic oracle' 정상
❌ ② not only — 'not only of credentialed experts but also of uninformed idiots', 상관접속사 정상
❌ ③ are likely to appear — 'they are likely to appear high on such rankings', be likely to 구문 정상
✅ ④ misleading(오류) — 주어 we가 오도당하는 수동 관계이므로 'to avoid being misled'가 맞음. 'to avoid misleading'은 '우리가 남을 오도하는 것을 피하다'로 의미 왜곡 ←정답
det.tip: avoid being+p.p. = ~당하는 것을 피하다(수동). we는 오도당하는 입장 → being misled

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is ③<u>democratic</u> ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control. Far from being an electronic oracle infallibly dispensing wisdom, it contains the views not only of ④<u>uncredentialed</u> experts but also of uninformed idiots ― and everything in between. There is, of course, a huge amount of useful, ①<u>accurate</u> and trustworthy information online, but it is not always easy to find. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by ②<u>popularity</u> rather than truth. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to evaluate it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷은 민주적이다. 자격을 갖추지 못한 전문가뿐 아니라 무지한 사람들의 견해도 담는다. 정확한 정보도 있다. 검색 순위는 인기에 의해 결정된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① democratic — '인터넷은 민주적이다'로 개방성 강조, 적절
✅ ④ uncredentialed(오류) — 본문은 'credentialed experts(자격 갖춘 전문가)'. uncredentialed로 바꾸면 '자격 없는 전문가'가 되어 모순 ←정답
❌ ② accurate — '유용하고 정확한 정보'로 문맥 적절
❌ ③ popularity — '인기에 의해 결정된다'로 적절
det.tip: credentialed experts = 자격을 갖춘 전문가들. uncredentialed(자격 없는)로 바꾸면 논리 모순

questions.passage: The upside of the Internet is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no ②<u>quality control</u>. Search engines like Google may help, but it is important to keep in mind that page rankings are determined by popularity rather than ④<u>truth</u>. Since conspiracy theories surrounding events such as 9/11 are popular, they are likely to appear high on such rankings, but this does not mean they are true. So if we are to avoid being misled, we need not only the ability to locate information, but also the critical thinking skills to ①<u>ignore</u> it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인터넷의 단점은 품질 관리가 없다는 것이다. 신뢰할 수 있는 정보가 있지만 찾기 어렵다. 검색 순위는 진실보다 인기 기준이다. 비판적 사고로 정보를 무시해야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ quality control — '품질 관리가 없다', 문맥 적절
❌ ② trustworthy — '신뢰할 수 있는 정보', 문맥 적절
❌ ③ truth — '인기가 아닌 진실에 의해', 문맥 적절
✅ ① ignore(오류) — 'the critical thinking skills to evaluate it'. 비판적 사고로 정보를 '평가(evaluate)'해야 함. ignore(무시하다)는 반대 의미 ←정답
det.tip: 글의 요지: 정보를 비판적으로 평가(evaluate)해야 함. ignore(무시)는 반의어

det.korean: 인터넷 장단점 서술이 본문과 일치하는가?
det.analysis:
✅ T: 'The upside... is that it is democratic ― anyone can say what they like ― but the downside is that there is no quality control' — 장점(개방성)과 단점(품질 관리 부재) 모두 본문과 일치
